supersedes.hash_algorithm: sha256 over the file bytes as committed; git_blob is the git object id of the same bytes

class_basis: declared session with a stated method (felt-sensor mutual report) and a declared reading (verdict + quality + friction_source); both parties self-observed

added_fields.measurand: calibration verdict (calibrated / not) with quality and friction_source, per the record's 'method' and 'readings' fields; is_trajectory_point=true, verdict_persisted=false

note: Appended per the logs mechanism (2026-09-09): logs/ is append-only; the original entry stays readable and unmodified; this correction supersedes it by content hash. An entry whose run cannot be reconstructed is classed UNDETERMINED with fields set unknown rather than skipped.
recorded_by_basis: readings.human.self_observed=true and readings.ai.self_observed=true; method states 'mutual report'
